items.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ streamer known as Clavicular set to be arraigned on rape charge
items.brief: The “looksmaxxing” livestreamer Braden Peters, better known by his stage name Clavicular, is set to be arraigned Thursday in Massachusetts on charges that he raped a 17-year-old girl at his family’s Cape Cod home.

items.title: Airbnb rule change frees guests from chores involving ‘significant effort’
items.brief: Airbnb has revised its rules to reduce the tasks a host can expect a guest to perform at the end of their stay — and washing dishes has been wiped from the to-do list.
